info.cls_ename: Department of Risk Management and Insurance

description.describe_ch: 本課程介紹風險理財的概念過程與方法，包含保險概論、財產損失風險、責任損失風險的法定基礎、管理責任風險、個人損失風險、淨利損失風險、預防風險的方法以及現金流量分析。
description.describe_eh: The introduction of this course is to study financial risk management, and to establish a risk management program. Other issues, such as assessing property loss exposures, liability loss exposures, personnel loss exposures, net income loss exposures, understanding forecasting data on past losses, and applying cash flow analysis are mentioned.

targets.describe_ch: 能獲悉風險理財的基本概念
targets.describe_en: To know the basic concepts of risk financing.

targets.describe_ch: 能應用專業知識來解決企業面臨重大損失風險的融資對策
targets.describe_en: To apply the professional knowledge to solve the risk financing problems for a firm suffering from a big loss.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
課堂行為
同學、教師或其他講師間，應保有彼此尊嚴和相互尊重，才能進行有效的學習。為了確保有利於學習環境，冀望每個人都能做到以下幾點，彼此遵守課堂行為規則，習慣禮貌的文化：
1)學生應準時出席上課。如果你的上課時間，無法按時到課，請不要選課。 除非你生病或有緊急情況，否則應在上課前，要準時到達教室，並坐在位子上。如果你有某種原因必須提早下課，請提前告知我。
2)所有學生在課堂上都應尊重每個人，並且在任何時候都應以合理、負責和禮貌的態度行事。
3)上課時請勿講話、閱讀、睡覺或做其他非本課程相關作業，除分組進行討論外，否則應盡量減少對話。
4)當同學簡報或提問時，你應該專心地聆聽。當你在簡報時，你應該面對自己的小組或全班同學大聲說話，讓同學能聽清楚。
5)上課時請將任何會發出聲音的電子設備調整為靜音模式
6)課堂上可使用筆記型電腦或平板等設備做筆記，其餘用不到的電子設備應收起。
7)不得戴耳機上課。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Course Policies
1)Students should attend class on time. If you cannot arrive at the class on time due to your class time, please do not register for the class. Unless you are sick or there is an emergency, you should be in your classroom on time and in your seat before class starts. If you have to leave class early for any reason, please let me know in advance.
2)All students are expected to treat everyone with respect in the classroom and to behave reasonably, responsibly, and courteously at all times.
3)Do not talk, read, sleep or do other non-course-related homework during class, except for group discussions, otherwise marginal conversations should be minimized. If you are sitting next to someone who might be chatting with you during class, move to another seat so you don't give in to temptation.
4)You should listen attentively when classmates present or ask questions. When you present, you should speak loudly to your group or class so that they can hear you clearly.
5)Laptops or tablets are allowed to take notes in class, otherwise they should be put away.
6)Make sure that mobile devices such as mobile phones and PDAs are turned off during class, and put away and keep silent.
7)Students are not allowed to wear earphones in class.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
課程交流及網路禮儀，所有學生應遵守以下聯絡規則：
1)以o365信箱作為聯繫老師之溝通工具。
2)與教師和班上的同學進行電子郵件、公告欄等交流時，要寫清楚資訊，保持禮貌。
3)您的電子郵件要署名並附上學號，我不會回覆“匿名”信件。
4)身為金融學院的學生，商用書信禮儀至關重要。因此每一次寄出電子郵件都是一次的練習，請同學在寄出電子郵件前檢查信件內文的用字遣詞、語法和標點符號等是否合宜。如果你只是將一行訊息傳給我（如“我將在本星期五缺席。”），我不會受理。
6)週一至週五期間，我將在24小時內回覆同學們針對課程學習來信提問的電子郵件。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
All students shall abide by the following communication regulations:
1) Teaching and learning uses o365 mailbox as a common tool for teachers and students to communicate in teaching and learning.
2)When communicating with teachers and classmates in emails, bulletin boards, etc., write the information clearly and be polite.
3)Your e-mail must be signed & your student ID must be provided, I will not reply to "anonymous" letters.
4)As a student of the College of Finance, business letter etiquette is very important. Therefore, you should treat send an email as a practice every time. Please check whether the wording, grammar, punctuation, etc. of the letter are appropriate before sending an email. If you just send me a one line message (eg "I will be absent this Friday."), your request will not be accepted.
5) From Monday to Friday, if anyone asks questions about course learning, I will reply to the email within 24 hours. If you just send me information (eg "I will be absent this Friday."), I will not write back to you.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
在專題報告，可以觀察及審閱同學彼此的學習任務、與同學合作，以完成書面報告。但是，當你撰寫文章或論文時，文字必須是您自己所想和所寫的。
  • 你必須認真遵守用於確認語詞和想法來源的標準規則。如果你在報告中使用某作者的短句或引語，或者是另一位作者的用語或想法，則必須確認這些用語或想法的來源，並在報告中標註這些素材的出處。作者的姓名和在句子末尾，包含使用原材料的頁碼。
  • 如果報告有抄襲之情形，你的期末成績將為零分。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en: Plagiarism is a serious breach of academic trust. In schoolwork, our words and thoughts are the value of our work; so submitting someone else's work as our own is a form of theft. When you use someone else's words and ideas, whether by a famous author or a classmate, without acknowledging the source of those articles, words and ideas, you are plagiarizing.
